# AWF decisions

Use `agentic-brainstorming` to resolve a material choice. Use this skill only when an accepted decision's explanation should outlive implementation in AWF's explicit durable record. A record is historical explanation, not current state.

<!-- awf:edit format: default; create .awf/skills/parts/awf-decisions/format.md to override -->
## Format

Create `docs/decisions/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md` as plain Markdown using only:

```markdown
# <date> <slug>
## Context
## Decision
## Consequences
```

State the circumstances, accepted choice, and durable trade-offs. Do not add frontmatter, numbering, status, lifecycle, transaction protocol, or CLI requirement. Update current-state topics separately when represented reality changes.
